name: minecraft-dev
author: sikadi233
description: Minecraft development for DeepSeek Harness: Paper/Spigot plugins and Fabric/Forge/NeoForge mods across MC 1.7.10-26.3, offline API signature indexes, the mc_scaffold/mc_gradle tools, and a deterministic sharded pipeline (mc_arbitrate) with 21 audit rules.

permissions.filesystem: mc_scaffold writes files under the user-specified targetDir only; mc_codex writes the architecture brief and the last-message file under <projectDir>/.dsh/; minecraft-preset may write the bundled agent presets into $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets on boot (skipped when already present)
permissions.subprocess: mc_gradle executes gradlew inside the user-specified project directory; mc_codex runs the Codex CLI the user already installed with <projectDir> as its working directory (only from the Minecraft 架构师 preset) — by default through the official `codex app-server --stdio` protocol, which creates a real Codex session visible in the Codex desktop app, or via `codex exec` when mode=exec is requested
